basis_statement: Default governance role seeds keep the baseline operator, approval, audit, and support splits explicit instead of inferring permissions from UI presence. Step-up policy isolates human authentication elevation from approval and delegation truth. Approval policy keeps mutation authorization explicit instead of allowing elevated roles to self-materialize controlled changes.

role_templates.description: Reviews and approves guarded governance requests but does not own all tenant operations.
Reviews evidence and policy outcomes without staging customer or governance mutations.
Handles bounded support workflow and customer contact posture without receiving full-client or authority mutation rights.
Owns governed operator posture for tenant-scoped access review, client operations, and governance mutations.

principal_view.dominant_question: What may this principal do right now without collapsing delegation, approval, and authority-link truth into one opaque outcome?

role_template_matrix.dominant_question: Which baseline tuples does this role template grant directly before simulator context narrows or blocks them?

simulation_scenarios.narrative: Tenant admins may stage filings, but submit posture stays blocked behind explicit step-up even when delegation and link evidence are already bound.
simulation_scenarios.title: Tenant admin may submit filing only with step up and linked authority evidence

simulation_scenarios.narrative: Authority-link truth remains an independent layer. Step-up alone does not rescue a submission when the connector is missing or stale.
simulation_scenarios.title: Authority-link drift blocks filing even after step up

simulation_scenarios.narrative: High-consequence retention actions stay approval-gated. The simulator surfaces that requirement without pretending the mutation can run inline.
simulation_scenarios.title: Erasure execution requires explicit security review

simulation_scenarios.narrative: Service principals may hold support posture, but they cannot satisfy human-only declaration actions or step-up evidence.
simulation_scenarios.title: Service principal cannot sign client declaration
